rows.ARS:
Orange blend Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Super Trouper ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Gareth Fryer (1948-....) (United Kingdom, before 2008).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Fryer's Roses/Fryer's Nurseries Ltd. in 2009 as 'Super Trouper'.
Introduced in New Zealand by Matthews Nurseries Ltd. in 2012 as 'Christchurch'.
rows.Bloom: Orange - orange-red. Average diameter 3.5". Double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy. Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 33" (85cm).
